verdict.rationale: Firebase CLI (firebase-tools) supports scripted, headless deployment of Firestore/Realtime Database security rules, Cloud Functions, and Auth user import/export, and the MCP server also exposes project/auth/data management to agents, covering schema+auth+policies largely from the command line. However, there's no single documented 'init a full backend' one-shot command evidenced, and evidence doesn't show a non-interactive schema-creation flow (Firestore is schemaless, so 'schema' setup maps to rules/indexes only). missing for 10: a documented fully non-interactive scripted bootstrap command chaining project creation, schema/indexes, auth, and rules; independent hands-on confirmation of headless end-to-end setup.
